dossier.scp_unleashed.372.title: Peripheral Jumper
dossier.scp_unleashed.372.caption: Frame 14 of a corridor sequence. The blur at the right edge is not in frames 13 or 15.

page.title: Special Containment Procedures:
text: SCP-372 cannot be approached, tracked or cornered by ordinary means, as it is only ever seen at the edge of vision. It can only be pinned down when something holds it in plain sight, and keeps holding it. The apparatus and its procedure are %rrestricted%r.
**If SCP-372 is ever held, do not let the holding fail.**

page.title: Description:
text: SCP-372 is a very long, thin, insect-like organism, about two metres long, with ten jointed legs ending in small hooked claws. Its ridged body is olive and khaki. It has long antennae, bristles about the face, small mandibles and large, glossy teal compound eyes.

It shows itself only at the edge of a person's sight, clinging to a wall, ceiling or floor a short way off. When the person turns toward it, it is gone with a faint skittering. It has never harmed anyone. Sightings are more frequent in dim places.

page.title: Addendum 372-1: Interview
page.text: Researcher Vasquez, after six weeks of sightings: "It is always on the left. Then it is on the ceiling. I have stopped turning around. It is still there. I just cannot have it."

page.title: Addendum 372-2: Test Log
text: Test 372-03: twelve cameras covering a sealed room. The footage shows nothing, except one frame of one camera, at the edge of the shot.
Test 372-07: a subject stared at a fixed point for an hour and reported eleven sightings. %rNone were where the subject expected.%r

page.title: Addendum 372-3: Note
page.text: Written on the back of a requisition for optical equipment: "If we cannot look at it, we will have to build something that can. Then it will have to stay where it is seen."

entity.scp_unleashed.scp372_glimpse: Something at the edge of sight
block.scp_unleashed.scp372_anchor.toolti: An optical pylon with a ground lens, built to keep one thing where it can be seen.
block.scp_unleashed.scp372_anchor.detail: It needs steady power, and someone who knows what it is meant to look at.
block.scp_unleashed.scp372_anchor.wiring: Power it through an outlet on any face
block.scp_unleashed.scp372_anchor.lights: Status lamps: red when dark, amber when ready, green when holding
block.scp_unleashed.scp372_anchor.dark: What it holds is only as steady as its power.
block.scp_unleashed.scp372_anchor.dark_l: The lens is dark and cold.
block.scp_unleashed.scp372_anchor.refuse: The lens hums, but you cannot tell it what to look for.
block.scp_unleashed.scp372_anchor.elsewh: The lens strains toward something it cannot reach.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp372_anchor.1: A powered optical pylon. Its lens is ground to keep something in plain sight, once someone has learned what to look for.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp372_anchor.2: It draws %s SP/t from the wire network. Its lamps glow red while it is dark, amber while it stands ready and green while it holds.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp372_anchor.3: Whatever it holds is only as steady as the anchor itself. Keep it fed and keep it whole.
SCP-372: a very long, thin insect with many jointed legs and large teal eyes.
It does not attack anyone. It is seen only at the edge of vision, and it is gone the moment anyone looks straight at it.
It does not occur naturally. Its archive file has more on where it comes from.

archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp372.1: Do not expect to see it twice in the same place.
